More concerning, this could be exploited to deliver malicious payloads under the guise of a legitimate package if the binary were tampered with or if emulation is forced.

Given that the checksum matches the x86_64 binary and no actual aarch64 binary is provided, this constitutes a supply chain risk. Users on aarch64 systems may unknowingly install an inauthentic or non-functional binary, undermining platform integrity and trust. This misrepresentation violates packaging best practices and raises red flags about the maintainership or provenance of the package.
